Meet Christine Advanced Botox • Dermal Fillers • Hair Restoration • Skin Rejuvenation • SkinPen Microneedling in Portland, Maine Welcome to Chris Medical Aesthetics! I’m Christine Small, a Registered Nurse with over 20 years of experience and advanced training in Botox, dermal fillers, SkinPen microneedling, chemical peels, and hair restoration treatments. My approach combines medical expertise, artistry, and personalized treatment planning. Every treatment is thoughtfully customized with a focus on safety, balance, and achieving results that align with each client’s individual aesthetic goals — whether they are seeking subtle, undetectable enhancements or more noticeable facial balancing and enhancement. Schedule Today Located in Portland, Maine, Chris Medical Aesthetics serves clients from Falmouth, Cumberland, Yarmouth, Freeport, Scarborough, Cape Elizabeth, South Portland, Windham, & surrounding Southern Maine. Our Services Botox • Dermal Fillers • Lip Filler • SkinPen Microneedling • Hair Restoration • Chemical Peels • Medical-Grade Skincare • Portland, Maine Expert aesthetic treatments tailored to your unique features, preferences & aesthetic goals. Botox/Xeomin/Dysport Smooth fine lines and wrinkles, soften dynamic lines, and enhance facial features with neuromodulators tailored to your desired look. Dermal Fillers Restore volume, smooth wrinkles, and enhance facial features with dermal fillers tailored to your individual aesthetic goals. Hair Restoration Stimulate hair growth and improve hair thickness with FoLix, the first FDA approved laser hair restoration device–with proven effectiveness. SkinPen Microneedling + Chemical Peels Improve skin quality (texture, pigment, tone), stimulate collagen production with medical-grade microneedling and chemical peels.
